about: keel's checked list of stack plugins for configure section 7. Every entry was checked by hand on the date below: author, what it does, what it runs or needs. 'when' matches the project profile (languages by Linguist name, ecosystems by catalog id) or package names in the manifests. 'frameworks' are detected by package name and searched for in the user's marketplaces; with no match keel says so and offers a project skill. Entries are advice only; the user installs what they choose.

plugins.author: Anthropic
plugins.what: Code intelligence for PHP through the Intelephense language server.
plugins.why: After each edit Claude sees type errors and unknown methods at once, and finds definitions and callers exactly instead of by text search.

needs.note: free; some features need a paid Intelephense licence

needs.install: install clangd from LLVM (apt install clangd, brew install llvm, or the LLVM installer on Windows)

plugins.author: Laravel (official Boost package)
plugins.what: An MCP server from Laravel Boost: tools for Artisan, Eloquent queries, routes, migrations and the app state.
plugins.why: Claude works from the installed Laravel version and the app as it is, instead of general knowledge.

needs.note: the project needs the laravel/boost package (composer require laravel/boost --dev); the server runs php artisan boost:mcp

plugins.author: Microsoft
plugins.what: Microsoft Playwright MCP server: opens pages in a real browser, clicks, fills forms, takes screenshots.
plugins.why: QA can check the running app in a browser instead of guessing from the code.

needs.note: runs npx @playwright/mcp@latest; downloads browsers on first use

plugins.author: Prisma
plugins.what: Prisma MCP: Postgres management, schema migrations, SQL queries; can create Prisma Postgres databases.
plugins.why: Migrations and queries go through Prisma with its own guidance.

needs.note: may connect to your Prisma account

plugins.author: Supabase community
plugins.what: Supabase MCP: database, auth, storage and real-time of a Supabase project.
plugins.why: Claude reads the real Supabase schema and settings.

plugins.author: Upstash
plugins.what: Up-to-date documentation of libraries and frameworks, looked up on demand.
plugins.why: keel's 'docs before code' rule: when the installed code is not enough, Claude reads current docs instead of guessing.

needs.note: remote MCP server at mcp.context7.com (Upstash); library names you look up go to it; works without an account
